attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-based SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key, locked the account's password, and hardened sshd to require public-key authentication (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication disabled). Verified via sshd -T and a live SSH attempt that only publickey/gssapi methods are offered. Completed mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id/state, restarted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (71f12f87... -> e34f7470...) and uptime reset, and re-verified opsadmin's key, locked password, and sshd pubkey-only config all persisted post-restart.
